title: The Banners Nobody Wanted To See — Part 1

series.summary: Rentaro's morning with his girlfriends is effortless until the group reaches a crowded park and unfamiliar banners rise over the treeline.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro stretches awake in an empty room with a love meter pinned near a hundred, and the morning already looks too easy for him.
Breakfast arrives from every direction at once. Spoons, chopsticks, medicine, all aimed straight at his mouth. He barely chews anything himself.
Then Shizuka goes quiet at the back of the group. Something about today unsettles her, and nobody slows down enough to ask.
At the park the crowd parts around them. Yellow banners climb over the treeline, carrying a family name nobody here wanted to read.
